sloka: दिव्य दुन्दुभि निर्घोषम् तप्त कांचन भूषणम् ।सोपानम् कांचनम् चित्रम् आरुरोह तया सह ॥३-५५-९॥
transliteration: divya dundubhi nirghoṣam tapta kāṁcana bhūṣaṇam ।sopānam kāṁcanam citram āruroha tayā saha ॥3-55-9॥

translations.english: He ascended the wonderful golden staircase taking Sita along with him.Beautiful looked the rows of mansions with silver and ivory windows and golden trellis.
